questions.question: Why did this project exist (problem statement)?
questions.answer: Jenkins queue blocked deploys; team wanted GitHub Actions + reusable workflows.

questions.question: What was uniquely yours on this project?
questions.answer: Led migration for payments repos, secret handling, and deploy smoke suite.

questions.question: What metrics moved post-launch (or what qualitative signal confirmed success)?
questions.answer: Median time from merge to prod deploy ~90m→25m; flaky test rate cut roughly in half.
